archive_statistics_comparison.note: BAS total counts alignment records, including non-primary records; do not compare it with primary read count or interpret it as unique fragments.

PG.CL: bwa mem  -t 1 -B 4 -O 6 -E 1 -M -R $rg_string $reference_fasta_file $fastq_file(1) $fastq_file(2) | k8 bwa-postalt.js -p  $prefix_hla_hit $reference_fasta_file.alt | samtools view -1 - > $bam_file
bamsort SO=coordinate I=$input_bam O=$sorted_bam index=1 indexfilename=$output_index_file_name fixmates=1
bammerge I=$input_bam1 I=$input_bam2 ...... index=1 indexfilename=$output_index_file_name SO=coordinate > $merged_bam

java $jvm_args -jar GenomeAnalysisTK.jar -T BaseRecalibrator -nt 1 -l INFO -cov ReadGroupCovariate -cov QualityScoreCovariate -cov CycleCovariate -cov ContextCovariate -R $reference_fasta -o $recal_data.table -I $bam_file -knownSites $known_snps_from_dbSNP142

limitations: No contamination or biological identity inference
No duplicate removal, trimming, realignment or filtering
mapq_255_note: 255 means mapping quality unavailable, not high confidence
metric_scope: Flag, clipping and mapped-contig/MAPQ counts: all primary records. Length/base/quality metrics: primary records with sequence. Secondary/supplementary counts may overlap.
read_length_policy: At least 95% of primary sequence-bearing records at expected length; no trimming
